description.value: Brew Mountain Eatery is a café and casual eatery situated just inside the gates of Whistler RV Park on Highway 99, open to both campground guests and the general public passing through. The menu spans breakfast sandwiches, hand-crafted burgers, made-to-order pizzas, and locally roasted coffee from Forecast Coffee, a B.C. roaster, with seasonal menus shifting between hearty winter comfort food and lighter summer fare. The park setting includes outdoor seating with mountain views, and the business also offers year-round catering for events and tours.
